method: numerical search with symmetry reduction (group Td) started from a Td-invariant cannonball packing (FCC lattice, code/cannon_cube.py), then orbit elimination and large-neighbourhood search of code/cubature_search.py; checked numerically in the symmetry-reduced system; the weights were then minimised in the L2 norm under all moment equations with a penalty for nodes outside the domain and the symmetry kept (tools/minimize_l2.py)
author: Claude (Anthropic), commissioned and directed by Joerg Kubitz
